baseline_models.focus_anchor: The jussive imperative فَلْيَنظُرِ directs the human toward the marked object إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sight and insight are deliberately aimed at what is ordinarily tasted and taken in; the meal becomes evidence to be apprehended rather than background consumed without notice.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight supplies the deliberate act of apprehension and makes looking more than a passing glance.
Perceiving by sight, sense, or hearing makes the human the creature capable of turning ordinary intake into noticed evidence.
Tasting and taking in fixes the object as concrete nourishment while exposing the normally automatic act to reflection.

changed_reading.before: The human merely sees or eats a familiar meal.
changed_reading.after: The human is ordered to interrupt consumption and deliberately apprehend the familiar meal as evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative of looking and the possessive طَعَامِهِ make one's own means of sustenance the object of scrutiny.
baseline_models.mechanism: The watcher-inspector image in looking combines with food as provision and livelihood: the human audits the condition that sustains the visible self.

activation_trace.role: A watcher who looks and guards turns the imperative into attentive inspection of a sustaining resource.
Visible human presence supplies the embodied beneficiary whose apparently independent condition is being examined.
Provision, livelihood, and good condition widen food from an edible item to the means by which a life is maintained.

changed_reading.before: His food is a private object ready for use.
changed_reading.after: His food is the inspectable provision on which his embodied condition depends.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طَعَامِهِ can retain literal food while its root inventory activates discernment, worth, and responsiveness to correction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Looking with insight at what the self takes in becomes a test of whether intake produces discernment and whether the eater remains corrigible.

activation_trace.role: Insightful examination provides the reflective operation applied to intake and its effects.
The self or intimate inner companion localizes the inquiry in the eater rather than in food classification alone.
Discernment, worth, and responsiveness to correction make nourishment a possible figure for formative intake without erasing literal food.

changed_reading.before: Food changes only the eater's bodily state.
changed_reading.after: The eater is asked whether what enters and sustains him also leaves him perceptive, valuable, and open to correction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast between turning away from a blind person who purposefully approaches and being diverted elsewhere revises looking into an ethical allocation of attention. Food, as lowly universal provision, becomes a corrective object that strips status from the gaze.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight is the focus action whose direction the opening scene puts under ethical pressure.
Provision and livelihood supply the ordinary dependency through which prestige-biased attention can be recalibrated.
Turning the back and averting supplies the failed direction of attention that the focus imperative reverses.
Loss of physical sight creates the paradox that the person without sight may be the one wrongly unseen.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end marks the approaching person as actively receptive rather than negligible.
Being occupied away from one thing by another names the attentional failure repaired by the later command to look.

structural_cues: 80:1-10 repeatedly stages bodily orientation, approach, blindness, and distraction before 80:24 issues a fresh command of directed looking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed directions of attention and the later food-directed imperative; I infer that dependence visible in food retrains the earlier status-selective gaze. A live alternative is that the opening only establishes a general moral posture and does not specify why food is the corrective object.

changed_reading.before: Look attentively at a neutral natural object.
changed_reading.after: Repair how attention is assigned by looking at the ordinary dependency shared beneath differences of visibility and status.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is held in written sheets, handed through revealing or book-bearing agents, and then a branch image unexpectedly turns the righteous carriers into grain. This makes food coexist with the written reminder as a materially delivered, readable communication.

activation_trace.role: Insightful examination supplies the act by which a material provision can be read rather than merely used.
Provision and livelihood give the second medium its bodily and economic substance.
A reminder that causes remembering supplies the communicative function later transferred analogically to food.
The written sheet supplies an explicitly readable material carrier.
The handing hand contributes transmission through an embodied chain rather than disembodied information.
A book that uncovers what is written links the carriers to disclosure and legibility.
The branch image of grain and wheat creates the surprising lexical bridge from honored carriers to the later object of eating.

structural_cues: The 80:11-16 reminder-and-carrier sequence precedes the focus, while 80:25-32 unfolds a second delivery chain after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written reminder, embodied transmission, a grain branch, and a command to inspect food; I infer an analogy in which provision communicates through matter. The live alternative is that the two delivery sequences remain separate examples and the grain branch is only resonant wordplay.

changed_reading.before: Food is evidence only because its causes can be reconstructed.
changed_reading.after: Food can also be received as a bodily delivered reminder, a material text whose legibility depends on looking.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failure to complete what was commanded is immediately followed by a new imperative. Looking at food becomes a remedial act: it uncovers provision that ingratitude covers and tests whether the human can become responsive to correction.

activation_trace.role: Directed insight supplies the concrete action demanded immediately after the charge of noncompletion.
Discernment and responsiveness to correction make the food inspection a diagnostic of moral educability.
Covering a benefit names the failure that attention to one's provision can reverse.
Completion and bringing to an end sharpen the explicit charge that the demanded task remains unfinished.
Demand and obligation make the following food-directed imperative a candidate instance of the unfulfilled command.

structural_cues: 80:23 ends with what he commanded him, and 80:24 begins immediately with the jussive imperative فَلْيَنظُرِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies noncompletion, obligation, covered benefit, and an adjacent imperative; I infer that looking at food is offered as a first remedial performance. A live alternative is a looser topic transition in which the new imperative illustrates dependence without specifying the prior command.

changed_reading.before: The verse recommends optional contemplation of nourishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse demands an enacted uncovering of provision in response to unfinished obedience and covered benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is a hinge between the human's water-origin, burial, and renewed life and the food's water, split earth, and growth. Looking through the counterpart branch makes the eater's cycle and the eaten cycle illuminate one another.

activation_trace.role: Matching counterpart with counterpart licenses a controlled comparison between the eater's sequence and the food's sequence.
Successive formation lets food retain within it a process rather than appearing as an isolated finished item.
Water ranging from drop to sea and including generative fluid supplies the human side of the shared water-origin pattern.
Concealment of the dead in a grave supplies the human descent into earth before reopening and life.
Reviving the dead after death gives the human sequence its explicit return to life.
Splitting and opening the earth supplies the corresponding emergence-space on the food side.
Human growth and nurture inside the plant root inventory reverses the domains and makes growth genuinely reciprocal as an image.

structural_cues: 80:18-22 narrates the human sequence, 80:24 commands comparison, and 80:25-32 narrates the food sequence with repeated water, earth, opening, and life motifs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered life processes around a focus branch of counterpart matching; I infer that the medial command asks the eater to recognize his own cycle in food's cycle. The live alternative is that the postfocus sequence explains food alone and carries no backward analogy to burial and renewed life.

changed_reading.before: Trace food backward to causes external to the eater.
changed_reading.after: See the eater mirrored in the eaten: both are water-begun, earth-bound, opened, formed, and brought into life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular finished noun food is unfolded into ordered operations: pouring, opening, growing, cutting, extracting, and making available for use. Looking therefore follows a hidden material chain rather than stopping at appearance or ownership.

activation_trace.role: Examination and reflection provide the backward tracing operation applied to the finished meal.
Fruit reaching ripeness and taking on flavor places maturation inside what appears simply as food.
Pouring and flowing supply the first energetic input in the production chain.
Splitting and opening supply the transformation of resistant ground into a growth medium.
Causing planting and growth supplies the conversion from inputs into living produce.
Cutting and separating introduce harvest and processing rather than treating growth as immediately edible.
Oil as the pressed essence of olives adds extraction and transformation to the chain.
A usable thing that meets needs marks the chain's endpoint in practical sustenance.

structural_cues: The clause beginning 80:25 answers the food-directed imperative with first-person plural actions followed by a catalog of outputs and beneficiaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered material actions and usable outputs; I infer a causal chain terminating in the possessive food of 80:24. A live alternative is that the sequence displays abundance without asking the reader to reconstruct every production stage.

changed_reading.before: Food is the finished item immediately present to its possessor.
changed_reading.after: Food is the visible endpoint of a distributed process of water, opened ground, growth, harvest, transformation, and delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possessive his food initially centers the human eater, but pasture and explicit benefit for humans and livestock redistribute the field. His provision belongs to an interspecies allocation in which edible and useful growth exceeds him.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence establishes the initially centered beneficiary whose centrality the later allocation revises.
Feeding another and asking to be fed turns food into a relation between provider and recipient rather than mere possession.
Pasture and herbage extend edible provision beyond the human menu.
Enjoyed and useful benefit supplies the shared function assigned to the whole produce list.
Livestock wealth identifies nonhuman recipients within the same provisioning system.

structural_cues: The singular possessive his food at 80:24 opens into the paired beneficiaries for you and for your livestock at 80:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human possessor, relational feeding, pasture, and paired beneficiaries; I infer that possession is nested in shared allocation. A live alternative is that livestock are listed only as human property, leaving the frame mainly anthropocentric.

changed_reading.before: The human surveys food as an exclusively personal possession.
changed_reading.after: The human sees his food as one share in a wider ecology of recipients, uses, and dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root frames an early claim of self-sufficiency and a late affair that wholly occupies each person. Between them, looking at one's provision exposes received dependence. The possessive does not prove autonomy; it reveals what autonomy must conceal.

activation_trace.role: Reflective inspection performs the exposure of dependence rather than allowing possession to remain self-evident.
Provision and livelihood are the concrete dependencies that contradict imagined self-sufficiency.
Wealth or dispensing with need supplies the explicit early posture challenged by the focus.
Sufficiency as something that fully occupies or answers a need reverses the earlier voluntary claim into an imposed isolation.
A grave affair or condition supplies what finally consumes each person's attention.

structural_cues: The two غ ن ي occurrences at 80:5 and 80:37 enclose the food imperative and reverse who or what is sufficient for whom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sufficiency language, a central provision object, and a late all-consuming affair; I infer that food is the hinge exposing false autonomy. A live alternative is that the two غ ن ي constructions are locally distinct and do not form an intentional frame around 80:24.

changed_reading.before: Calling it his food confirms the human as owner and self-provider.
changed_reading.after: Calling it his food directs him to the received supports that disprove self-sufficiency before an affair isolates him completely.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates grafting and body-building images far from the ordinary noun food, including a food-building branch under the contextual word for sons. It remains anchored in طَعَامِهِ through direct grafting and successive-formation branches and is reinforced by growth and flesh-building branches. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for incorporation, not as a replacement lexical meaning of طعام.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus food root itself includes accepting an inserted graft and continuous formation, allowing ingestion to be imagined as incorporation into the eater.

activation_trace.role: A branch accepting a graft supplies the image of nourishment as foreign material received into a living continuity.
Continuous successive formation supplies the ongoing body process into which food is incorporated.
Human growth and nurture make plant production cross back into the eater's own development.
Food building flesh and causing its growth supplies the explicit constructive arrow from intake to body.

changed_reading.before: Food remains an external object that disappears in consumption.
changed_reading.after: Food is an accepted material graft that continues building the human who looks at it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries botanical ripening and the splitting of a date spathe into the later description of human faces. It remains anchored in the focus through the appearance branch of looking and the ripening branch of food, while the later face sequence supplies disclosure, first signs, brightness, and dust. Downstream prose should qualify it as a harvest-like surface analogy, not an equation of people with plants or a claim that the facial terms literally denote crops.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Looking at food joins visible appearance to ripening, making surfaces readable as outcomes of hidden formation.

activation_trace.role: What appears to a viewer supplies the readable surface on which an underlying condition becomes visible.
Fruit reaching maturity and taking on flavor supplies ripening as the process whose result can be inspected.
The lighting or unveiling of a face makes one outcome visibly disclose itself.
The splitting of the date spathe and early dates imports a sharply botanical emergence image into the smiling-face sequence.
First signs or beginnings supply the moment at which a latent outcome breaks onto the surface.
Dust and earth coloration supply the contrasting surface on which the other outcome remains visibly deposited.

changed_reading.before: Looking at food ends once its hidden causal history is understood.
changed_reading.after: Looking at ripened food trains a reading of formed outcomes on surfaces, culminating in faces that disclose contrasting harvests.

strongest_changes: The imperative becomes an ethical repair of misdirected attention rather than detached observation.
Its immediate placement after unfinished command turns food inspection into enacted uncovering of concealed provision.
The surrounding human and agricultural sequences make eater and eaten reciprocal process analogues.
The postfocus actions unfold a finished meal into a hidden supply chain and a shared ecology.
The repeated sufficiency root makes one's food evidence against autonomy rather than proof of ownership.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah functions as a compact hinge: one ordinary possessive object activates social attention, moral correction, material transmission, causal ecology, self-knowledge, and eschatological surface-reading without requiring those readings to collapse into one. The strangest live branches make food an accepted graft and make later faces harvest-like disclosures.
remaining_uncertainties: The reminder-food parallel may be a structural analogy, while the grain branch under ب ر ر may be only a productive resonance.
The eater-food life-cycle correspondence is strongly positioned but does not force every stage into a one-to-one mapping.
The shared-provision reading depends on treating livestock as co-recipients rather than only assets within a human economy.
The graft and ripened-face outliers require explicit analogical containment because their branch paths are deliberately cross-domain.
